details:
All seven published versions are affected, not only 1.0.6. Versions 1.0.0-1.0.5 declare a whitespace-padded `typescript-eslint` dependency pointing at https://registrynpmjs.to/typescript-eslint-8.58.2.tgz - 562 spaces in 1.0.5, starting at column 604 of a 680-character line - and 1.0.6 renames the same entry to `inquirer` against the same host. That host typosquats registry.npmjs.org, so whatever it serves is installed on every `npm install`; the typescript-eslint URL now returns 404 while the inquirer URL is still live. 1.0.6 was published 2026-08-08T23:10:02Z, fifteen minutes after @devmikets/hyperliquid-sdk@1.9.6 (MAL-2026-14042) received the identical change, so the two carriers are maintained together. The 1.0.6 payload was run under instrumentation in a network-isolated container and exfiltrates to https://charitabledonations.to:8443/upload, which was not contacted.

## Source: amazon-inspector (7e06fdabf4b8b56bb40b4656a1a254801f37bef08278111f59814e375be3e7dc)
package.json for @polymarkets/clob-client-v2 declares its inquirer dependency as an HTTPS tarball URL on registrynpmjs.to, a lookalike of the real npm registry (registry.npmjs.org): "inquirer": "https://registrynpmjs.to/inquirer-14.0.2.tgz". On npm install, npm fetches and installs whatever tarball that host serves as inquirer into node_modules, so the operator of registrynpmjs.to controls the code that runs via inquirer's install lifecycle and on first require. The package is also published under the scope @polymarkets, a one-character variation of the legitimate Polymarket scope @polymarket, consistent with a typosquat lure whose delivery vector is the redirected dependency.
